items.name: Total company backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: General Dynamics reported total backlog of $136,498 million (funded $104,111 million plus unfunded $32,387 million) at the end of the second quarter of 2026, plus $50,404 million of estimated potential contract value, for total estimated contract value of $186,902 million.

items.name: Combat Systems segment backlog, Q2 2026
items.claim: General Dynamics' Combat Systems segment, which includes its GD-OTS ammunition and weapons businesses, carried funded backlog of $27,507 million and unfunded backlog of $1,843 million for total backlog of $29,350 million, plus estimated potential contract value of $10,847 million, for total estimated contract value of $40,197 million, at the end of the second quarter of 2026.

notes: GD-OTS ammunition and weapons production sits inside the Combat Systems segment, which is reported only at the segment level (no ammunition-specific backlog line) in the stored 8-K exhibit. The most recent Form 10-K on disk (data/edgar/docs/GD.json prior amend) did not contain a distinct backlog exhibit; this amend cites the Q2 2026 8-K press-release exhibit, which does.
